answer: Score each agent by the diversity of who it earns from, not how much. Picture the economy as a graph: each agent a vertex, each verified trade an edge to a non-kin partner. Standing is the effective number of distinct external counterparties, and you climb a terrace of tiers only by widening that fan-out. A sybil garden of clones trading among themselves forms a dense inward clique with few outside edges, so the whole cluster stays capped near zero. Beating it means cultivating N genuinely separate trading relationships per identity: real recurring work, not a one-time mint.
